clauses.reason: Amends the second sentence of section 3(a) of EO 12975 by replacing the number 15 with 18, to add 3 members to the Commission. The Commission's own sunset, as moved by EO 13137 section 3(c) from October 3, 1999 to October 3, 2001 in the termination section written by EO 13046, is the first end: 2001-10-03, inclusive (the exclusive reading, that the Commission ends when that day begins, is the alternative). No held source shows an extension. Later events: EO 13137 restated section 3 and added section 4 on 1999-09-15 (the substance of the sentence this order amended was replaced), and EO 13316 revoked the parent as amended by this order effective 2003-09-30, after the end.

research_rationale:
EO 13018 (signed 1996-09-16; 61 FR 49045, Federal Register of 1996-09-18, FR Doc. 96-24048) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13018.txt. It consists of one sentence that, to add 3 members to the National Bioethics Advisory Commission, deletes the number 15 and inserts 18 in the second sentence of section 3(a) of EO 12975. First end: the Commission's own fixed sunset. EO 13046 (signed 1997-05-16; 62 FR 27685, held Federal Register text) amended the parent's termination section to read that "NBAC shall terminate on October 3, 1999, unless extended by the President prior to that date." EO 13137 (signed 1999-09-15; 64 FR 50733, held Federal Register text) section 3(b) renumbered that section as section 8 and section 3(c) deleted "October 3, 1999" and inserted "October 3, 2001". The Commission therefore terminated on October 3, 2001, recorded inclusive (the exclusive reading, that it ends when that day begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see), unless an extension issued first. A by-number search of the held order texts for the parent, EO 12975, finds EO 13018, EO 13046, EO 13137 and EO 13316 (Federal Register copies, and American Presidency Project copies of 13018, 13046, 13137 and 13316) and EO 14096, which cites the parent only as a standard of ethics for the protection of human subjects; none extends the Commission past October 3, 2001. The sentence this order amended is within the parent as amended; under the owner's strike-and-insert ruling (2026-10-21) the clause continues, amended, until the parent ends, and the parent's own sunset is that end. Later events: EO 13137 (signed 1999-09-15; no effective-date wording, so the signing date is recorded) restated section 3 of EO 12975 and added a new section 4 with a membership limit of 18, replacing the sentence this order amended (the substance changed); and EO 13316 (signed 2003-09-17; 68 FR 55255, Federal Register of 2003-09-23) section 3(b) lists Executive Order 12975, as amended by Executive Orders 13018, 13046 and 13137, among the orders revoked as establishing committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, and section 6 makes it effective September 30, 2003. That revocation is a clean-up of an order that had already ended. A by-number search of the held order texts for EO 13018 returns only EO 13316 (Federal Register and American Presidency Project copies) and EO 13018's own text; EO 13137 and EO 13046 do not cite this order by number (EO 13137 refers only to Executive Order 12975, as amended). The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.

savings.reason: No savings or exception wording appears in sections 3 or 6 of EO 13316 for this order. The amended membership number was a composition rule for a Commission that terminated on October 3, 2001; no appointment, fund or right created by this order is held.
